gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Professional and modern in feel, Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous gaps where curves meet stems, while Joystix shouts in wide-tracked arcade capitals above it. Lines move along smoothly, with little jump between cases.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads modern and neutral, its terminal tips flaring outward and its lowercase climbing nearly to cap height. gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Joystix brings bold arcade attitude, with widely tracked letters and stems barely heavier than their arms, to the top of the pair. It excels at punch, while Noto Sans Arabic handles quiet clarity.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian is approachable and polished, with tall, full lowercase and wide, inviting round letters. Joystix delivers arcade punch in wide-spaced capitals, whereas Noto Sans Armenian handles the steady, welcoming work of sustained text.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Joystix spaces its arcade lettering far apart, with stems only a shade thicker than the arms joining them. Noto Sans Avestan follows with a tall x-height and open curve tips, and Joystix earns its keep when set big and brief.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Loud, spaced-out arcade type up top. Joystix brings the swagger and Noto Sans Balinese answers with short ascenders and a breathing space inside every curve, and the two sit together like a game cabinet beside a quiet bookshelf.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Joystix is all wide-tracked arcade lettering with a restrained thick-thin rhythm. Its strongest trait is the contrast against Noto Sans Bamum, whose curved strokes stop short of turning inward and leave big open counters in every small letter.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Joystix has a subtle weight change, like etched lines in glass, spread across wide-tracked arcade letters. Noto Sans Bassa Vah then fills a line with a dominant midsection and open-jawed c shapes, giving longer text a dense, confident texture.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-batak: Joystix is arcade-bold, widely tracked and sturdy. Its thinnest strokes stay solid and its thickest stay restrained, so it earns its place big and short, while Noto Sans Batak brings a towering x-height and a wide-open e.
